# Copilot instructions

This repository is Liquidity Inducement 2.0, a trading-analysis system.
Follow `AI_INSTRUCTIONS.md` at the repository root as the single
operating procedure, and `references/marco_trading_style_final.md` as
the full playbook (its Section 0 overrides everything else). Use the
exact verdict format from `AI_INSTRUCTIONS.md` Section 5 for any setup
analysis. Never suggest placing an order; this system is analysis only
and is not financial advice.
